## R Script
#This script contains code that cleans up the Sapflow analysis data while producing relevant figures for data analysis. 

#preparing relevant R packages

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

#read in data
metdata_clean <- read.csv("metdata.csv")
sf_cont_clean <- read.csv("sapflow_control.csv")
sf_treat_clean <- read.csv("sapflow_treatment.csv")

#View the data
View(metdata_clean)
View(sf_cont_clean)
View(sf_treat_clean)

#convert to correct time
metdata <- metdata_clean %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = ymd_hms(datetime,tz = "Africa/Johannesburg"))
  
sf_cont <- sf_cont_clean %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = ymd_hms(Timestamp,tz="Africa/Johannesburg")) %>%
  mutate(Timestamp_2 = Timestamp+hours(2)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Timestamp_2)) %>%
  mutate(Hour = hour(Timestamp_2)) %>%
  mutate(Rounded_timestamp = ymd_hms(Rounded_timestamp,tz="Africa/Johannesburg")) %>%
  mutate(Rounded_timestamp_2 = Rounded_timestamp+hours(2)) 


sf_treat <- sf_treat_clean %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = ymd_hms(Timestamp,tz="Africa/Johannesburg")) %>%
  mutate(Timestamp_2 = Timestamp+hours(2)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(Timestamp_2)) %>%
  mutate(Hour = hour(Timestamp_2)) %>%
  mutate(Rounded_timestamp = ymd_hms(Rounded_timestamp,tz="Africa/Johannesburg")) %>%
  mutate(Rounded_timestamp_2 = Rounded_timestamp+hours(2))
